name: RicoMafia
description: RicoMafia (also known as 0430) is a hybrid street gang active on Detroit's northwest side, centered around the Seven Mile and Telegraph corridor. The group's name derives from a local individual known as "Rico," reportedly born on April 30 — the origin of the "0430" moniker. Rather than following a single traditional gang lineage, members adopt Blood-, Vice Lord-, or Crip-leaning affiliations depending on personal ties and block-level alliances. The crew has a notable digital footprint, with social media activity contributing significantly to its visibility and to conflicts with rival Detroit street cliques including 1229 ReaperGang and SpiderGang.

sources.title: Understanding Hybrid and Mixed-Affiliation Groups in Metro Detroit
